description: Scatters whole USER-WRITTEN MOTIFS the way texture simple scatters single events: motif onsets fall at the packing interval (randomised by scatter), each statement transposed to a random start pitch between minpich and maxpich, its internal shape exactly as written. The notedata file carries line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of the input, then ONE OR MORE '#N' motif blocks (rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur'); several blocks give the texture a vocabulary to pick from; zero blocks refuse 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' Pinned to submode 5 (NONE - free pitch; modes 1-4 force notes onto hfield/hset blocks, and mode 1 was verified to differ from its 'motifsin' sibling at the same seed: motifs forces only motif START notes onto the field, motifsin bends EVERY note). multlo/multhi (CDP-enforced 0.01-100 verbatim) scale each statement's duration. Genuinely stochastic with a WORKING -r seed (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; -r9 differs). Duration honesty: outdur 5 -> 5.20 (+4.1%), outdur 8 -> 8.61 (+7.6%). Breakpoints: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim); every other numeric positional plus -a/-p/-s accepts (full sweep; packing additionally VERIFIED against both scalar endpoints at seed 5). Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO. Flag order enforced (family).
musical_use: A cloud of melodies instead of a cloud of dots: write one or more little tunes and the engine strews transposed statements of them across the texture - birdsong-like scatterings, gamelan figuration, canonic swarms where the same shape enters at many pitches. packing is the density knob (tight = overlapping polyphony, sparse = isolated calls); minpich-maxpich sets the transposition field (keep both at the notedata pitch for unison-height statements); multlo/multhi vary statement pacing (sub-1 values snap motifs into ornament-length bursts, >1 stretch them into slow lines). Multiple '#N' blocks build a motif vocabulary the texture rotates among - two contrasting shapes at wide packing reads as call-and-response. Time-varying (breakpoint) packing sculpts swarm density; time-varying minpich/maxpich sweeps the register. Contrast texture grouped (random shapes) and tmotifs (motifs at COMPOSED times). Always seed to pin a take.

notedata.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file()): line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of the input sound; then one or more '#N' blocks of rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' - the motif shapes (times ascending within a block; amp 1-127; dur seconds). No blocks: 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

outdur.description: Requested (minimum) duration; actual ran +4.1% (outdur 5) to +7.6% (outdur 8) over - the last motif statement's tail extends past the grid. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

packing.description: Average time between MOTIF onsets (family range). Breakpoint-capable and VERIFIED: a 0.3->1.5 brk at seed 5 differs from both scalar-endpoint renders.

scatter.description: Randomisation of motif onsets (family range 0-10). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

tgrid.description: Quantised timegrid for motif start times, ms (0 = none). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

sndfirst.description: First sound from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

sndlast.description: Last sound from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

minpich.description: Minimum start pitch of motif statements (MIDI; transposition relative to the notedata pitch). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

maxpich.description: Maximum start pitch of motif statements (MIDI). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

phgrid.description: Timegrid in ms WITHIN motifs (0 = none). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpspace.description: Spatialisation of motif-groups 0-5 (family values). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 14').

gpsprange.description: Spatial range of motif-groups 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

amprise.description: Amplitude change within motifs 0-127 (default 0). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

contour.description: Amplitude contour of groups 0-6 (banner; grouped-family set, no 7/8 extras here). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 17').

multlo.description: Minimum multiplier of each motif statement's total duration (CDP-enforced 0.01-100: 'Parameter[17] Value (0.000000) out of range (0.010000 to 100.000000)'). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

multhi.description: Maximum motif-duration multiplier (>= multlo). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

atten.description: Overall attenuation multiplier (family range 0.000002-1). Breakpoint accepted. Flag order enforced: -a -p -s -r then switches.

position.description: Centre of the stereo image 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

spread.description: Spatial spread of texture events 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

seed.description: Random seed - WORKING (-r5 pair byte-identical; -r9 differs). 0/omission = clock. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 30').

whole.description: Play the whole input per event, ignoring duration values (verified: changes render).

samedur.description: Notes of any one motif all take the same duration (verified: changes render).

instrvary.description: Motifs not confined to a fixed instrument - multi-input only. Listed in the banner's parameter text though absent from its usage line; ACCEPTED (verified byte-identical no-op on this single-input entry).

examples.description: Birdsong swarm: a rising three-note motif scattered every ~0.8 s across an octave.
examples.expected_use:

#3
0 1 60 64 0.3
0.15 1 64 64 0.3
0.3 1 67 64 0.3'). Transposed statements strew across the stereo field; rerun with seed 5 for the identical take.

examples.description: Density swell: packing breakpoint tightening from sparse calls to overlapping polyphony.

known_issues: Duration honesty (set_by outdur): +4.1% at outdur 5, +7.6% at outdur 8 on the 0.5 s-ping probe; duration row pinned at outdur 8, tol 0.2, seed 5.
Notedata needs the pitch line plus at least ONE '#N' motif block ('Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' otherwise); several blocks legal (vocabulary).

SIBLING BYTE-PROOF: motifs 1 vs motifsin 1 at the same seed render the SAME LENGTH but different samples (motifs forces only motif START notes onto the harmonic field; motifsin bends every note). motifsin has NO mode 5 ('Program mode value [5] is out of range [1 - 4].' verbatim) and is dropped - its useful modes are all harmonic-field modes, which the curated texture set leaves to execute().

Breakpoint surface: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim); all 13 other numeric positionals plus -a/-p/-s accept (full sweep; packing verified against both endpoints at seed 5).
The banner's usage line lists only [-w] [-d] but -i is accepted (and described lower in the same banner) - single-input no-op, multi-input only.
Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO. Flag order enforced (family). Working -r seed.
